test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question: IANA oversees the allocation of IP address to organisations and individuals. What is the full form of IANA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Internet Assigned Numbers Authority**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) **

 
 
• The **IANA** is a standards body that manages **media types, global IP address allocation, root zone management in the Domain Name System (DNS), autonomous system number assignment**, and other Internet Protocol-related numbers and symbols.
 
• It is **currently carried out by** **ICANN**, a nonprofit private American business **founded in 1998** largely for this purpose under a contract with the **United States Department of Commerce**.
 
• From **1998 until 2016**, IANA was run by ICANN directly before being handed to **Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), an ICANN subsidiary that still manages IANA today**.
 
• Before that, **Jon Postel oversaw IANA primarily at the University of Southern California's (USC) Information Sciences Institute (ISI)**, located in Marina Del Rey (Los Angeles), as part of a deal the USC/ISI had with the US Department of Defense.
 
• IANA performs its duty in close coordination with the **RFC Editorial team and the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regional Internet Registries (RIRs)** receive IP address block allocations from IANA.
 
• **Addresses are distributed** by each RIR for a certain region of the globe.
 
• The **Number Resource Organization was established by the RIRs** collectively as a body to represent their shared interests and guarantee that global policy statements are coordinated.
 
• **IANA facilitates the registration of protocols** and manages protocol registries **in tables of parameters and protocols**.
 
• There were more than** 2,800 registrations and sub registries as of 2015**.
 
• IANA is responsible for maintaining the **IETF RFC5646-defined IANA Language Subtag Registry**.
